The '''Second Mission to Orto Plutonia''' was a mission carried out by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]]. It was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] campaign to destroy the [[Radar-cloaking superweapon]]. Denal was tasked with finding the plans for the weapon in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] research station on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], which he successfully acquired.
